title: ACM womENcourage 2026 Hackathon
description: Build tech solutions for well-being and inclusion in computing at a full-day in-person hackathon in Sophia Antipolis, France. Open to participants of all genders aged 18 and above.
descriptionDetailed: The womENcourage hackathon runs on the opening day of the ACM Celebration of Women in Computing, focusing on how computer science can drive well-being. Participants work in teams through ideation, solution development, slide deck creation, and a final pitch before judges. The hackathon is open to all genders, nationalities, and experience levels - interest in technology is the only requirement - and is included in conference registration.

entry.feeNote: Hackathon access is included in conference registration. Early rates from EUR 90 (student ACM member) to EUR 590 (industry); late rates are higher. Scholarships provide free registration to selected students and early-career professionals.

audience.eligibilityLabel: Open to all genders aged 18 and above
audience.eligibilityDetail: No prior IT experience is mandatory; interest in technology is the key requirement. Multidisciplinary teams from computer science, software development, cybersecurity, data science, AI, design, and related fields are encouraged.
